sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: The suffix -ba/-be expresses movement into a place or destination. It contrasts with -ban/-ben for being inside a place.

Compare konyhában (‘in the kitchen’) with konyhába (‘into the kitchen’) — the only difference is that little -n dropping off. Losing that final consonant is literally the grammar of losing your stillness: you’re no longer sitting in the kitchen, you’re heading toward it.
